description: This file defines two Orleans grain classes, 'VersionUpgradeTestGrain' and 'VersionPlacementTestGrain', which are used for testing versioning and placement strategies in an Orleans-based distributed system. It includes methods for retrieving grain versions, performing async tasks, and logging activation/deactivation events.

classes.name: VersionUpgradeTestGrain
classes.description: A Grain class that tests version upgrades, implementing methods to get version, invoke other grains, and handle lifecycle events with logging.

classes.name: VersionPlacementTestGrain
classes.description: A Grain class that tests placement strategies based on version, providing methods to retrieve version and manage lifecycle with logging.

methods.name: GetVersion
methods.description: Returns the current version number of the grain.

methods.name: ProxyGetVersion
methods.description: Calls another grain's GetVersion method and returns its result.

methods.name: LongRunningTask
methods.description: Performs a delay for a specified duration to simulate a long-running task.
